declarations.description:
A field that turns typed or pasted text into a list of removable tags — recipients, keywords, labels.

How text is split into tags is up to you. By default a comma or Enter commits the pending text. `delimiters` lists
every character that commits (`delimiters=",; "` also accepts semicolons and spaces), `split-pattern` replaces that
with a regular expression (`[\s,;]+`), and pasted text is always split on the same delimiters plus line breaks and
tabs, so a column copied from a spreadsheet lands as one tag per line. The `parseTag` property normalizes each token
before it is added (trim, lowercase, pull the address out of `Name <address>`), `pattern` / `validator` decide
whether a tag is valid, and a cancelable `tag-add` event can veto any tag.

Invalid tags are kept and marked (the form is invalid until they are removed) unless `reject-invalid` is set, which
leaves the text in the input instead. Duplicates are ignored unless `allow-duplicates` is set.

Keyboard: Backspace in the empty input or ArrowLeft at its start moves to the last tag; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight walk
the tags; Backspace/Delete remove the focused tag; Enter on a tag puts it back into the input for editing.

The value is an array of strings. In markup separate tags with semicolons (`value="a@x.com;b@x.com"`). In a form
each tag is submitted as its own entry under `name`, like a multiple `<select>`.

cssProperties.description: Space between tags, and between the last tag and the input.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tag-input--gap

cssProperties.description: Narrowest the input gets before it wraps to a new line.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tag-input__input--min-width

cssProperties.description: Space between a tag's text and its remove button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tag-input__tag--gap

cssProperties.description: Longer tags are truncated with an ellipsis.
cssProperties.name: --c2-tag-input__tag--max-width

cssParts.description: The bordered box holding the tags and the input.
cssParts.name: field

cssParts.description: The remove button of a tag.
cssParts.name: remove-button

cssParts.description: The text input after the tags.
cssParts.name: input

slots.description: Icon at the start of the field, before the tags.
slots.name: prefix-icon

slots.description: Replaces the cross of every tag's remove button.
slots.name: remove-icon

members.name: rejected
members.description: Set when the last commit refused invalid text, which stays in the input; cleared by the next edit.

members.name: value
members.description: The tags. In markup, separate them with semicolons.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name. Each tag is submitted as its own entry under this name.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown in the input while there are no tags.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the input.

members.name: delimiters
members.description: Every character in this string commits the pending text as a tag when typed, and splits pasted text. Enter always commits.

members.name: splitPattern
members.description: Regular expression source that splits text into tags, e.g. `[\s,;]+`. Takes precedence over `delimiters`.

members.name: parseTag
members.description: Normalizes each token before it becomes a tag. Returning `null` or `''` drops the token. Property only.

members.name: addOnBlur
members.description: Commits the pending text when the input loses focus.

members.name: pattern
members.description: Regular expression every tag must match, anchored like the native `pattern` attribute.

members.name: validator
members.description: Custom tag validation, run after `pattern`. Return `true`, or `false` / a message for an invalid tag. Property only.

members.name: rejectInvalid
members.description: Refuses invalid tags: their text stays in the input instead of becoming a marked tag.

members.name: allowDuplicates
members.description: Allows the same tag more than once.

members.name: max
members.description: Maximum number of tags; `-1` for no limit. The input is hidden once the limit is reached.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires at least one tag for the form to be valid.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the field.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Shows the tags but refuses edits.

members.name: error
members.description: Marks the field invalid (red border). Invalid tags set it implicitly.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: inputValue
members.description: The text typed in the input that has not become a tag yet.

members.name: invalidTags
members.description: The tags that fail `pattern` or `validator`.

members.name: checkValidity
members.description: Checks all current constraints and fires `invalid` on this element when they fail.

members.name: reportValidity
members.description: Checks all current constraints and asks the browser to show validation feedback.

members.name: setCustomValidity
members.description: Sets or clears a custom validation error.

members.name: addTags
members.description:
Adds tags as if the user had entered them: each goes through `parseTag`, validation, the duplicate and `max`
checks and a `tag-add` event. Returns the tags that were added.

members.name: removeTag
members.description: Removes the tag at `index` as if the user had removed it. Returns whether it was removed.

members.name: commit
members.description: Commits the pending text in the input.

members.name: split
members.description: Splits text on the delimiters, and on line breaks and tabs (pasted text).

members.name: commitTokens
members.description:
Turns tokens into tags. Returns the tags added and the tokens refused (rejected invalid tags, vetoed tags and
tokens over the limit), which the caller keeps in the input.

members.name: commitText
members.description:
Commits every complete piece of `text`. With `final` the trailing piece is committed too; otherwise it stays in the
input as the text being typed.

members.name: joiner
members.description: What joins refused tokens back together in the input.

members.name: editTag
members.description: Removes a tag and puts its text into the input.

members.name: focusTag
members.description: Focuses the tag at `index`, or the input when `index` is past the last tag.

events.name: input
events.description: Fired after `value` changes through user interaction. Typing in the input does not fire it.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after `value` changes through user interaction.
Cancelable. Fired before a tag is added; `preventDefault()` rejects it and keeps the text in the input.
events.name: tag-add

events.description: Cancelable. Fired before a tag is removed; `preventDefault()` keeps it.
events.name: tag-remove
